Name: Seasonal Outfits for Katsuki Bakugo from My Hero Academia
Author: bezajel
Description:
[size=3]Vanilla-style portraits, slightly-cuter sprites, and seasonal outfits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/emkabonbonka]emkabonbonka[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46075]Katsuki Bakugo from My Hero Academia NPC Mod[/url][/size]

This mod was created in unison with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Blossom5280]Blossom[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46660]Portraits for Kacchan[/url] mod, which provides anime-style portraits compatible with my seasonal sprites.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/46336/46336-1779374067-320628674.png[/img]

[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Portraits in bezajel's almost-vanilla style[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Sprites suitable for vanilla or slightly-cuter - with nose or no-nose option[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Can mix-and-match portraits or sprites with the original mod (non-seasonal only) or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46660]Blossom's portraits[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Seasonal outfits for Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter (indoor + outdoor), Beach, and Spirits Eve[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Resort dialogue added to fix a missing dialogue key error from original mod[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Plenty of angry but adorable attitude[/color][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/46336/46336-1779374068-760459212.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have the required mods installed. These are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46075]Katsuki Bakugo from My Hero Academia NPC Mod[/url][/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract (unzip) the file[/*]
[*]Place the unzipped folder into your Mods folder[/*]
[*]Play the game! [color=#999999][if you ever can't find him, check behind the JojaMart][/color][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/46336/46336-1779374071-428296749.png[/img]


[color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is recommended for setting config options, but if you wish to do it the manual way, you can edit the config.json that is generated when you first launch the mod. All options are true/false. Default values are indicated in [b][u]bold and underlined[/u].[/b][/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]VanillaPortraits [[b][u]true[/u][/b] | false]
Enable Vanilla-Style Katsuki portrait. This replaces the portrait from the Katsuki Bakugo NPC Mod.

CuteSprites [[b][u]true[/u][/b] | false]
Enable Slightly Cuter Style Katsuki sprites. This replaces the sprites from the Katsuki Bakugo NPC Mod.

NoNose [true | [b][u]false[/u][/b]]
Enable to remove Katsuki's nose in his side-facing sprites.

SeasonalOutfits [[b][u]true[/u][/b] | false]
Enable Katsuki seasonal outfits. If this is enabled, both portraits and sprites will be changed, regardless of the options selected above.

BeachGoggles [true | [b][u]false[/u][/b]]
Enable to let Katsuki wear his welding goggles on the beach. For the sun, you know. Or fashion. Requires seasonal outfits to be enabled.

WinterGoggles [true | [b][u]false[/u][/b]]
Enable to let Katsuki wear his welding goggles outdoors during winter. For the snow-blindness, you know. Or fashion. Requires seasonal outfits to be enabled.

SpiritsEveHero [[b][u]true[/u][/b] | false]
Enable Katsuki wearing his hero costume to Spirit's Eve. If disabled, he will wear his fall or default outfit instead. Requires seasonal outfits to be enabled.

Dialogue [[b][u]true[/u][/b] | false]
Add missing resort dialogue. This can be disabled if resort dialogue is added by the Katsuki Bakugo NPC Mod.[/color]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/46336/46336-1779374071-1110389997.png[/img]

Thankyou [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Blossom5280]Blossom[/url] for introducing me to Katsuki and asking me to create beach and winter sprites for him to support [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46660]her own Katsuki portrait mod[/url]. I don't think either of us realised how far I'd run with it.

Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/emkabonbonka]emkabonbonka[/url] for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46075]Katsuki Bakugo mod[/url]. I based Katsuki's spring outfit on his design in the original mod.

Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/VoidWitchCult]VoidWitchCult[/url] for their [url=https://ko-fi.com/s/9bf8a95bf8]NPC Sprite Template[/url], and to Blossom for purchasing it for this project. I used the template as a base for Katsuki's character sprites, and this saved me a heap of time. The only part of the character base I didn't edit was the Flower Dance outfit, which remains Void's original work.

Other than the contributions listed above, all spritework, outfits, portrait art, code, and resort dialogue are my own work, with design references and character lore provided by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Blossom5280]Blossom[/url].

The headings used in mod page images and description were made with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/kdau]kdau[/url]'s [url=https://www.kdau.com/scrollish/]Stardew Scroll Generator[/url].
